::: {.doc-intro #overview}
<p class="doc-kicker">R in the Cloud</p>

## Overview

RStudio is a powerful integrated development environment (IDE) for R programming. Coder workspaces allow you to run RStudio Server, which provides the full RStudio interface accessible securely through any modern web browser.
:::

::: {.doc-step #create-workspace}
::: {.doc-step__number}
1
:::
::: {.doc-step__body}
<p class="doc-kicker">Configuration</p>

## Creating a Workspace with RStudio

```{=html}
<div class="doc-callout doc-callout--note">
  <span class="doc-callout__icon" aria-hidden="true">ℹ</span>
  <div>
    <strong>Enable during creation</strong>
    <div><p>RStudio must be enabled when the workspace is created. It cannot be added to an existing workspace after creation.</p></div>
  </div>
</div>
```

1. Navigate to the **New Workspace** page at [coder.dreamlab.ucsb.edu](https://coder.dreamlab.ucsb.edu).
2. Complete the required workspace name and policy checks.
3. Make sure **Include RStudio** is set to **Yes**.
4. Click **Create Workspace**.

Once booted, launch RStudio in a new browser tab with the RStudio button on the dashboard:

![Coder workspace dashboard showing RStudio button on port 8787.](../images/workspace-rstudio.png)
:::
:::

::: {.doc-step #projects}
::: {.doc-step__number}
2
:::
::: {.doc-step__body}
<p class="doc-kicker">Organization</p>

## Setting Up an RStudio Project

RStudio Projects organize your scripts, datasets, and working directories cleanly:

1. In RStudio, click **File → New Project**.
2. Select **New Directory**.
3. Choose **New Project**.
4. Enter a directory name (e.g., `my-project`) and keep the parent directory set to `~`.
5. Click **Create Project**.

RStudio generates an `.Rproj` file storing project-specific settings so you can easily resume work.
:::
:::

::: {.doc-step #packages}
::: {.doc-step__number}
3
:::
::: {.doc-step__body}
<p class="doc-kicker">Packages &amp; Git</p>

## Installing Packages & Git Setup

Install packages in your cloud RStudio session just like a local installation:

```r
# Install from CRAN
install.packages("tidyverse")
install.packages("ggplot2")

# Install from GitHub
install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("username/repository")
```

```{=html}
<div class="doc-callout doc-callout--tip">
  <span class="doc-callout__icon" aria-hidden="true">i</span>
  <div>
    <strong>Isolated Package Storage</strong>
    <div><p>Packages installed in your workspace persist across sessions within your persistent home directory, isolated from other workspaces to ensure reproducibility.</p></div>
  </div>
</div>
```

### Setting Up Git

Open the Terminal in RStudio (**Tools → Terminal → New Terminal**) and configure your identity:

```bash
git config --global user.name "Your Name"
git config --global user.email "your.email@example.com"
```
